# Neverlose-style UI vendor

Source: user-provided neverlose-ui-main.zip, originally https://github.com/ImInsane-1337/neverlose-ui.
Modified locally for embedded offline loading, mobile viewport scaling, touch activation, single-column pages, reduced effects, optional file APIs. The uploaded source is retained separately outside the project.

## Original license
README labels the source MIT; LICENSE was not included in the provided archive. Preserve upstream attribution and verify license before redistributing.
